quizName:
Hardest Questions in Pennsylvania
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming conditions or hazards. This sign warns you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: Why is night driving more difficult than daytime driving?

options.text: Cars overheat more quickly at night.
You cannot see as far ahead in the dark.
You are more likely to see motorcycles at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot see as far ahead in the dark.
questions.explanation: At night, you cannot see as far down the road. Always use your headlights. Drive slowly enough to stop within the distance you can see ahead.

questions.question: You are at a stop sign but cannot see cross traffic clearly. What should you do?

options.text: Roll down your windows, listen for traffic, then proceed.
Move forward slowly, look for traffic and pedestrians, then proceed when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move forward slowly, look for traffic and pedestrians, then proceed when it is safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign where you cannot see clearly, yield to pedestrians. Slowly pull forward past the stop line until you can see the intersection. Check for traffic and pedestrians. Proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: A school bus has stopped with its stop arm extended. What should you do?

options.text: Stop completely and wait until it is safe to proceed.
Honk your horn and pass the bus on the left.
Continue driving when you think the children are done getting off.
Pass the bus before its door opens.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and wait until it is safe to proceed.
questions.explanation: When you see a stopped school bus with its stop arm out, you must stop completely. Do not proceed until the stop arm is pulled in.

questions.question: You missed your freeway exit. What should you do?

options.text: Make a U-turn through the median.
Pull onto the shoulder and back up to your exit.
Flag down a police officer to escort you back.

questions.explanation: Take the next exit. Never stop, back up, or cross multiple lanes on a highway. Do not cross the median to turn around. These actions are illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: What is the legal drinking age in this state?
questions.explanation: The legal drinking age in Pennsylvania is 21.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in your current direction.

questions.question: Your blood alcohol level is 0.04 percent. What is true?

options.text: You are two to seven times more likely to crash than someone with no alcohol in their blood.
You are above the legal limit but still safe to drive.
You should drink coffee before driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are two to seven times more likely to crash than someone with no alcohol in their blood.
questions.explanation: No amount of alcohol is safe before driving. Even at 0.04 percent blood alcohol, which is below the legal limit for adults 21 and older, you are two to seven times more likely to crash than someone with no alcohol.

questions.question: You missed your turn or exit on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Make a quick turn from your lane.
Continue driving until the next exit or safe place to turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue driving until the next exit or safe place to turn around.
questions.explanation: Do not back up on a freeway. Go to the next exit or find a safe place to turn around. Backing up on a freeway shoulder is illegal.

questions.question: There are no signals at a railroad crossing. What should you do?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if you see or hear a train.
Speed up to cross the tracks quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if you see or hear a train.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with no signals, slow down and be ready to stop if you see or hear a train approaching.

questions.question: Before passing another vehicle, you should:

options.text: Flash your headlights to warn the driver.
Turn on your four-way flashers to warn the driver.
Use your turn signal to show you are changing lanes.
Honk your horn to get the driver's attention.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your turn signal to show you are changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Before passing, check that the passing lane is clear. Use your turn signal early so other drivers know what you plan to do.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. Where this sign is posted, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: Before turning, you should:
questions.explanation: Turn on your signal 3 to 4 seconds before you turn. This gives other drivers time to know what you plan to do.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver is behind you, you should:

options.text: Make eye contact with the driver.
Speed up as they pass you.

questions.explanation: Get out of the way of an aggressive driver. Do not look at them or speed up, as this may make them angrier and more dangerous.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause you to crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the steering wheel
Take your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that takes your attention, eyes, or hands away from driving.

questions.question: When a school bus has flashing lights and its stop arm out, you must:

options.text: Stop at least 10 feet away from the bus.
Pass if all children have left the bus.
Stop only if the bus is on your side of a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop at least 10 feet away from the bus.
questions.explanation: When a school bus flashes red lights and extends its stop arm, you must stop at least 10 feet away, unless the bus is on the other side of a divided highway.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossing road and intersection are ahead.
